source.name: IaCSecBench
source.license_note: Only the source's generated, labeled AWS internal cases are read. Terraform source files are not copied into TerraMind; only derived numeric features and provenance identifiers are retained.

inclusion.case_policy: Include directories under benchmark/internal/cases whose metadata is generated by benchmark/generate_corpus.py and provider is aws.
inclusion.grouping: pair_id; vulnerable and compliant variants of one control must remain in the same validation fold.

exclusions: Kubernetes provider cases: TerraMind's first ML scope is AWS Terraform.
CIS-illustrating examples with unrecorded source provenance.
External repositories: retained as future unlabeled out-of-distribution evaluation candidates, not training labels.
leakage_controls: The training script selects only FEATURE_NAMES; sample_id and group_id are excluded from model inputs.
HCL is parsed to structured values, so generated header comments containing expected labels are not model features.
Validation uses GroupKFold grouped by pair_id/control.
The four CIS examples and all unlabeled external repositories are excluded.
limitations: The corpus contains controlled generated pairs, not production incident outcomes.
A positive label means violation of the case's named benchmark control, not deployment failure, outage, or cost risk.
Only 23 independent AWS control pairs are available; performance is exploratory and uncertainty is high.
Case specifications may contain labeling errors; the source documents a known construct-validity disagreement and other limitations.
